items.title: Data-Efficient Machine Learning Potentials for Organic Reactions through Active-Learning-Guided Fine-Tuning
items.abstract_or_text: Transition states (TSs) are central to reaction barriers and mechanisms, yet their accurate localization remains computationally demanding. Reactive machine learning potentials can accelerate TS optimization by rapidly predicting potential energy surfaces, but achieving chemical transferability requires extensive sampling and quantum chemical (QC) labeling of reactive conformations. Here, we introduce an active-learning-guided fine-tuning strategy that couples pretrained chemical knowledge for broad generalization with adaptive labeling of informative reactive conformations for data efficiency. The resulting MACEPre-DeePEST-OS enables efficient TS optimization and barrier predictions across diverse organic reactions while requiring QC labeling for only ~2% of approximately 19 million candidate conformations. Across three in-distribution benchmarks, MACEPre-DeePEST-OS achieves an average root mean square deviation of 0.080 Å for TS geometries and a mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.938 kcal/mol for barriers. In cross-dataset evaluation on an external OrgReact subset, fine-tuning reduces the barrier MAE by 58% relative to the pretrained model. Out-of-distribution testing on a Ugi reaction network containing structures with more than 70 atoms yields a barrier MAE of 1.09 kcal/mol, indicating transfer to molecular sizes and reaction complexity beyond the fine-tuning data. These results establish a data-efficient route toward transferable reactive potentials for quantitative analysis of reaction mechanisms and competing pathways.
items.summary_zh: 提出 MACEPre-DeePEST-OS：以预训练化学知识为基础、由主动学习选择量子化学标注构象的反应机器学习势。该方法仅标注约 1,900 万候选构象中的约 2%，便在多类有机反应中实现过渡态优化与能垒预测，并报告了跨数据集和超出微调分子规模的测试。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将主动标注与预训练反应势结合，直接针对反应机理计算中最昂贵的过渡态定位环节；外部 OrgReact 和 Ugi 网络结果增强了可信度。仍须留意，验证主要是计算基准，尚未显示其对实验动力学或复杂真实反应体系的端到端提升。
items.abstract_zh: 过渡态（TS）对于反应能垒和机理至关重要，但其精确定位仍然在计算上要求很高。反应性机器学习势可通过快速预测势能面加速 TS 优化，但获得化学可迁移性需要对反应构象进行广泛采样和量子化学（QC）标注。本文提出一种主动学习引导的微调策略，将用于广泛泛化的预训练化学知识与对信息量大的反应构象进行的自适应标注相结合，以提高数据效率。由此得到的 MACEPre-DeePEST-OS 能够在多样有机反应中高效进行 TS 优化和能垒预测，而仅需对约 1,900 万个候选构象中的约 2%进行 QC 标注。在三个分布内基准中，MACEPre-DeePEST-OS 对 TS 几何结构实现了平均均方根偏差 0.080 Å，并对能垒实现了平均绝对误差（MAE）0.938 kcal/mol。在外部 OrgReact 子集的跨数据集评估中，相较于预训练模型，微调将能垒 MAE 降低了 58%。在包含大于 70 个原子的结构的 Ugi 反应网络上进行分布外测试，得到 1.09 kcal/mol 的能垒 MAE，表明可迁移至超出微调数据的分子大小和反应复杂度。这些结果建立了一条数据高效的途径，可获得用于定量分析反应机理和竞争路径的可迁移反应性势。
items.author_line: Kaipai Ren, Yujing Zhao, Kun Tang, Juntao Wang, Guangran Zhang, Qilei Liu

items.title: Integrative Physics and Machine Learning-Based Optimal Binding Pose Generator for Protein-Ligand Complexes
items.abstract_or_text: Accurately identifying the optimal protein–ligand binding pose is crucial for reliable binding affinity prediction, as molecular dynamics–based approaches are highly sensitive to the initial structure. However, there is currently no efficient way to predict such poses. Indeed, we assess the capabilities of three proposed AI-based software solutions (AlphaFold3, Boltz and RoseTTAFold All-Atom) and demonstrate their substantial shortcomings in this context. Here, we present a combined physics-and machine-learning-based method that predicts optimal protein-ligand poses in their relaxed states, enabling rapid and cost-effective downstream estimation of binding affinities. We apply our approach to two targets, tankyrase 2 (TNKS2) and the 3C-like protease (3CLPro), using datasets of 10,000 molecules for each system. Evaluation on an external validation set of approximately 3,000 molecules demonstrates the method’s ability to generalize to previously unseen datasets, aligning with the practical needs of high-throughput drug discovery pipelines that iteratively evaluate new molecules. Our method substantially reduces the need for costly calculations by efficiently filtering out poses unlikely to yield favorable binding affinities upon relaxation.
items.summary_zh: 构建结合物理与机器学习的蛋白—配体最优结合姿势生成方法，针对 TNKS2 和 3CLPro 各使用 10,000 个分子的数据集训练，并在约 3,000 个分子的外部验证集上评估。作者称该方法可筛除松弛后不太可能具有有利结合亲和力的姿势，从而减少后续计算。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结合姿势是基于 MD 的亲和力估计的关键初始条件；该工作明确检验 AlphaFold3、Boltz 和 RoseTTAFold All-Atom 的不足，并提供外部验证。限制是只覆盖两个靶点，且摘要未给出与既有对接流程的定量、前瞻性药物发现收益。
items.abstract_zh: 准确识别最优蛋白—配体结合姿势对于可靠的结合亲和力预测至关重要，因为基于分子动力学的方法对初始结构高度敏感。然而，目前尚无高效方法能够预测这类姿势。事实上，我们评估了三种已提出的基于 AI 的软件解决方案（AlphaFold3、Boltz 和 RoseTTAFold All-Atom）的能力，并展示了它们在这一背景下的显著不足。本文提出一种结合物理与机器学习的方法，可预测处于松弛状态的最优蛋白—配体姿势，从而实现快速且成本有效的后续结合亲和力估计。我们将该方法应用于两个靶点，tankyrase 2（TNKS2）和 3C-like protease（3CLPro），每个体系使用包含 10,000 个分子的数据集。在约 3,000 个分子的外部验证集上进行的评估表明，该方法能够泛化至此前未见的数据集，这与高通量药物发现管线反复评估新分子的实际需要相一致。该方法通过高效筛除在松弛后不太可能产生有利结合亲和力的姿势，显著减少了对昂贵计算的需求。
items.author_line: Agastya P Bhati, Jinyu Dong, Sean Black, Shunzhou Wan, Vineeth Gutta, Xibei Zhang, Mateusz Bieniek, Darren V. S. Green, Sunita Chandrasekaran, Eric Stahlberg, Peter V. Coveney

items.title: Uni-Macro-FRPN: Full-Resolution and Cross-Scale Learning for Polymers
items.abstract_or_text: Polymer properties emerge from interactions across scales, yet existing polymer models typically preserve either detailed monomer chemistry without an explicit polymer graph or polymer connectivity with simplified monomer representations, due to computational constraints, as polymers typically contain tens of thousands of atoms. We present Uni-Macro-FRPN (FRPN), a Full-Resolution Polymer Network that retains both detailed atom-level and monomer-level features and explicit polymer structure information within a unified framework. Two Transformers jointly learn atom-informed monomer semantics, sequence order, and chain topology from BigSMILES-derived representations. On the Block Copolymer Database (BCDB) lamellar-versus-non-lamellar classification task, FRPN achieves 86.4% accuracy and 90.6% ROC–AUC, establishing state-of-the-art performance. Ablation results indicate that the gain is not explained solely by increased parameter count. On a linear homopolymer benchmark, monomer-centric learning remains competitive, highlighting a boundary case where polymer-scale organization is simple. To test generalization beyond linear polymers, we further construct an all-atom molecular-dynamics benchmark of 1640 datapoints spanning diverse monomer chemistries, sequence orderings, chain topologies, and physical properties. FRPN achieves the strongest overall performance on this topology-rich benchmark, with diagnostics supporting the benefit of jointly modeling monomer chemistry and polymer structure. Taken together, FRPN provides a practical route for moving polymer representation learning beyond monomer-centric representations. The leading performance of FRPN also suggests a promising direction for polymer informatics: future polymer prediction models should treat polymers not only as collections of monomer descriptors, but as complete multiscale chemical and topological objects.
items.summary_zh: Uni-Macro-FRPN 在统一框架中保留原子级、单体级及显式聚合物拓扑信息，以两个 Transformer 学习 BigSMILES 表征。在 BCDB 层状/非层状分类上达到 86.4% 准确率和 90.6% ROC–AUC，并新建包含 1,640 个点的全原子 MD 拓扑丰富基准。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它正面处理聚合物中局部化学与链级结构不可兼得的问题，并以消融、边界任务和新基准支持结论。性能仍主要来自模拟与分类任务；面对真实加工历史、配方和实验性质时的泛化尚待验证。
items.abstract_zh: 聚合物性质源于跨尺度相互作用；然而，由于计算约束——聚合物通常包含数万原子——现有聚合物模型通常要么保留详细单体化学而没有显式聚合物图，要么保留聚合物连通性而采用简化的单体表征。我们提出 Uni-Macro-FRPN（FRPN），一种全分辨率聚合物网络，在统一框架内同时保留详细的原子级和单体级特征，以及显式聚合物结构信息。两个 Transformer 从源自 BigSMILES 的表征中联合学习原子信息化的单体语义、序列顺序和链拓扑。在 Block Copolymer Database（BCDB）的层状与非层状分类任务上，FRPN 达到 86.4% 的准确率和 90.6% 的 ROC–AUC，创下最先进性能。消融结果表明，该增益并非仅由参数量增加所能解释。在一个线性均聚物基准上，以单体为中心的学习仍具竞争力，突出了聚合物尺度组织简单时的一个边界情形。为检验对线性聚合物以外体系的泛化，我们还构建了一个包含 1640 个数据点的全原子分子动力学基准，涵盖多样的单体化学、序列排序、链拓扑和物理性质。FRPN 在这一拓扑丰富基准上取得最强总体性能，诊断分析支持联合建模单体化学和聚合物结构的益处。总之，FRPN 为使聚合物表征学习超越单体中心表征提供了一条实用途径。其领先性能还表明，聚合物信息学的未来预测模型应将聚合物不仅视作单体描述符的集合，还应视作完整的多尺度化学和拓扑对象。
items.author_line: Jintao Wu, Yiran Shan, Rui Zhang

items.title: A World Model of Molecular Organization Detects Cryptic Pockets from Apo Structure
items.abstract_or_text: A cryptic pocket is a druggable site that is absent from a protein's resting structure and appears only once the backbone moves. It is the reason a target dismissed as undruggable from its crystal structure can still turn out to be druggable, and it is exactly what any method that reads a single static conformation will miss. The problem this paper takes on is finding these sites from an apo structure alone, on any protein rather than only the handful that come with a solved open-state or ligand-bound companion. Every established way of detecting a site that is visible only in the open state builds that state first, whether by sampling conformations or by predicting a bound complex. We do not build it. Our world model of molecular organization has already learned it and carries it in its latent, so we read cryptic pockets straight from that latent, per residue, from a single static apo structure, with no conformational sampling and no protein language model. The representation is never chained onto the output of a separate pocket finder, and a candidate pocket is a grown, disjoint set of residues rather than a ball of fixed radius. On CryptoBench, a set of 231 held-out apo chains, the detector localizes the cryptic site at top-1 0.848, top-3 0.931, and top-5 0.952 under a pocket-level overlap rule, using only the apo structure; on a 286-chain subset of CryptoBank it reads 0.846, 0.933, and 0.990. Scored residue by residue on CryptoBench, it reaches an AUC of 0.8465. On WRN helicase, held out of training entirely, it recovers at rank 1 the allosteric pocket bound by the clinical inhibitor HRO761, across three independent apo crystal forms and from the apo backbone alone; on the best-resolved form the rank-1 pocket covers 18 of the 22 annotated residues, including the C727 the drug contacts. Set against OpenDDE, the detector is complementary: on 190 targets held out of both training sets it recovers 119 sites OpenDDE misses, against 2 in the other direction, and at top-5 it misses none of the sites OpenDDE finds. It runs on any structure from the apo coordinates alone, including the mmCIF-only entries all recent depositions carry, and its accuracy keeps climbing as the training corpus grows. The intended use is prospective cryptic-site nomination on the targets that sequence and static structure leave without a starting point.
items.summary_zh: 该工作从单个 apo 蛋白静态结构的世界模型潜表示中，逐残基检测隐蔽口袋，无需构象采样、蛋白语言模型或上游口袋检测器。在 CryptoBench、CryptoBank 子集、未参与训练的 WRN helicase 以及与 OpenDDE 的互补比较中报告了较高检出率。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 若可稳健推广，方法可为静态结构看似不可成药的靶点提出变构位点。其证据包括严格留出靶点和临床抑制剂 HRO761 结合位点的回顾性案例，但尚非实际筛选与实验命中验证，性能也可能受基准构建和口袋定义影响。
items.abstract_zh: 隐蔽口袋是一种在蛋白质静止结构中不存在、只在主链发生移动后才出现的可成药位点。正因如此，一个仅从晶体结构看似不可成药的靶点仍可能最终被证明可成药；也正因如此，任何读取单一静态构象的方法都会错过它。本文处理的问题是：仅从 apo 结构、针对任何蛋白而非只针对那些具有已解析开放态或配体结合态配对结构的少数蛋白，寻找这些位点。每一种既有的、检测仅在开放态可见位点的方法都会先构建该状态，无论是通过构象采样还是预测结合复合物。我们不构建它。我们的分子组织世界模型已经学习了它，并将其保存在潜变量中，因此我们直接从该潜变量、按残基读取隐蔽口袋，只需一个静态 apo 结构，不进行构象采样，也不使用蛋白语言模型。该表征从不被串接到独立口袋发现器的输出上，候选口袋是一个生长的、互不相连的残基集合，而不是固定半径的球体。在 CryptoBench——一个含 231 条留出的 apo 链的数据集——上，在口袋级重叠规则下，该检测器仅使用 apo 结构即可将隐蔽位点定位至 top-1 0.848、top-3 0.931 和 top-5 0.952；在 CryptoBank 的 286 条链子集上，相应数值为 0.846、0.933 和 0.990。在 CryptoBench 上逐残基评分时，其 AUC 达到 0.8465。对于完全留出训练的 WRN helicase，它仅从 apo 主链、跨三种独立 apo 晶体形式，在 rank 1 找回了由临床抑制剂 HRO761 结合的变构口袋；在分辨率最高的构象中，rank-1 口袋覆盖 22 个注释残基中的 18 个，其中包括药物接触的 C727。与 OpenDDE 对比时，该检测器具有互补性：在两个训练集中都留出的 190 个靶点上，它找回了 OpenDDE 漏掉的 119 个位点，而反向仅有 2 个；在 top-5 时，它没有漏掉任何 OpenDDE 找到的位点。它可在任何仅有 apo 坐标的结构上运行，包括所有近期沉积条目所带的仅 mmCIF 条目，并且其准确率随着训练语料库增大而持续上升。预期用途是在序列和静态结构无法提供起点的靶点上，前瞻性地提名隐蔽位点。
items.author_line: Shihabi R, Taraman S, Vaughan B

items.title: Language-model-derived training data for polymer glass transition prediction: a controlled benchmark
items.abstract_or_text: Experimental polymer property data are scarce and costly, whereas large language models (LLMs) have absorbed much of the chemical literature and can be queried for a fraction of a cent per polymer. We ask whether LLM-produced data can replace or supplement experimental data for predicting the glass transition temperature (Tg). With Claude Sonnet 5 as the teacher we built two synthetic datasets for USD 10.28: a generated set of 7,912 polymers whose structures and Tg values were both written by the LLM, and a labeled set of 9,925 hypothetical PI1M polymers whose Tg the LLM predicted. Both were cleaned with RDKit, deduplicated with a cut-invariant polymer key, and purged of every polymer of a held-out test set (1,471 polymers) and validation set (589) drawn from a curated experimental collection. A fine-tuned MoLFormer student was trained along a learning curve of 250 to 5,297 real polymers, with and without a preceding stage on synthetic data, and compared with a fingerprint random forest, two controls (self-training pseudo-labels and shuffled labels) and the teacher’s own zero-shot predictions, over 5 seeds. Trained on synthetic data alone, the student reached a mean absolute error (MAE) of 36.8 ◦C (generated) and 38.5 ◦C (labeled), within about 1 ◦C of the teacher (37.3 ◦C) and far from a student trained on all real data (25.2 ◦C). Synthetic data helped only when real data were scarce: with 250 or 500 real polymers, a synthetic first stage reduced the MAE by 3 ◦C to 5 ◦C on average and on every seed, a gain that shuffled labels abolished and that free self-training pseudo-labels reproduced only in part; against a baseline trained with more patient early stopping it was 3 ◦C to 4 ◦C at 250 real polymers and about 2 ◦C at 500; with 5,297 real polymers the gain was below 1 ◦C and not distinguishable from zero. Of the unique generated polymers, 8.3 % were copies of real polymers, 56 % of the valid generated pairs were repeats, and the teacher’s labels were rounded to a few values and shifted to lower Tg. LLM-produced data are thus a cheap and, below a few hundred measurements, useful supplement, not a substitute for measurements.
items.summary_zh: 以 Claude Sonnet 5 生成或标注聚合物 Tg 数据，构建受控基准，比较经合成数据预训练的 MoLFormer、指纹随机森林及多种对照。结果显示，合成数据不能替代测量值，但在真实样本仅 250–500 个时可降低 2–5 °C MAE；作者同时量化了重复、复制和标签偏移。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究没有将 LLM 合成数据的价值泛化，而是通过严格隔离测试集、五个随机种子和负对照界定其有效范围，是对化学数据增强有用的校准证据。结论局限于 Tg、所用教师模型和小样本区间。
items.abstract_zh: 实验聚合物性质数据稀缺且昂贵，而大型语言模型（LLM）已吸收大量化学文献，并且每种聚合物的查询成本可低至美分的一小部分。我们询问：LLM 产生的数据能否替代或补充用于预测玻璃化转变温度（Tg）的实验数据。以 Claude Sonnet 5 为教师，我们以 10.28 美元构建了两个合成数据集：一个生成集，包含 7,912 种聚合物，其结构和 Tg 值均由 LLM 写出；一个标注集，包含 9,925 种假想 PI1M 聚合物，其 Tg 由 LLM 预测。两者均使用 RDKit 清理、用对切割不变的聚合物键去重，并清除了来自一个经整理实验集合的留出测试集（1,471 种聚合物）和验证集（589 种）的每一种聚合物。以 250 至 5,297 种真实聚合物构成的学习曲线训练微调 MoLFormer，在有或没有先行合成数据阶段的条件下，与指纹随机森林、两个对照（自训练伪标签和打乱标签）以及教师自身的零样本预测进行比较，跨 5 个随机种子评估。仅用合成数据训练时，学生模型达到平均绝对误差（MAE）36.8 °C（生成）和 38.5 °C（标注），与教师的约 37.3 °C 相差约 1 °C，但远不及用全部真实数据训练的学生模型（25.2 °C）。合成数据仅在真实数据稀缺时有帮助：使用 250 或 500 种真实聚合物时，合成数据第一阶段平均且在每个随机种子上将 MAE 降低 3 °C 至 5 °C；这一增益被打乱标签消除，而免费的自训练伪标签只能部分复现；相对采用更耐心早停训练的基线，在 250 种真实聚合物时降低 3 °C 至 4 °C，在 500 种时约降低 2 °C；使用 5,297 种真实聚合物时，增益低于 1 °C，且与零不可区分。在唯一生成的聚合物中，8.3%是对真实聚合物的复制，56%的有效生成配对为重复项，且教师的标签被舍入为少数几个数值并向较低 Tg 偏移。因此，LLM 产生的数据廉价，并且在少于数百个测量值时是有用的补充，但不是测量值的替代品。

items.title: Machine Learned Interatomic Forces as Inference-Time Physical Guidance for All-Atom Diffusion Peptide Design
items.abstract_or_text: Diffusion-based biomolecular generative models can efficiently explore peptidereceptor sequence-structure space, but the learned generative distribution does not explicitly represent the underlying atomistic potential-energy landscape. As a result, generated complexes may contain locally unfavorable atomic arrangements even when they remain plausible under the learned structural prior. Here, we develop an inferencetime physical guidance framework that couples machine learned interatomic potential (MLIP)-derived forces to the all-atom reverse diffusion trajectory of RFDiffusion3 for receptor-conditioned peptide design. Rather than applying energy minimization after generation, atomistic physical information is introduced before the joint sequencestructure trajectory termination. MLIP-derived forces therefore provide atomic coordinate corrections that are propagated through subsequent denoising steps, allowing physical information to influence not only atomic geometry but subsequent residue selection. The framework requires neither retraining nor modification of the pretrained diffusion model and uses late-stage force guidance, adaptive step-size control, and geometry-preserving projection to retain the underlying generative prior. Across eight receptor systems for peptide designs, MLIP guidance reduced peptidereceptor steric clashes by 24.7% and intrapeptide clashes by 37.4%, while promoting more hydrogen-bond-compatible interface geometries. Guided structures shifted toward more favorable energetic regions in both the guiding MACE potential and an independent MM/GBSA evaluation, with 82.4% of retained structures exhibiting more favorable MM/GBSA energetic estimates. These improvements were achieved with a median peptide backbone deviation of only 0.051 Å. Importantly, 95.0% of generated peptide sequences were preserved, whereas 5.0% underwent residue substitutions, demonstrating that physical guidance can feed back into sequence-structure generation without globally overriding the learned RFDiffusion3 distribution. This distinguishes inference-time physical guidance from post-generation relaxation, which optimizes only the coordinates at fixed chemical identity. More broadly, the results establish a general strategy for coupling pretrained biomolecular generators with differentiable atomistic energy models, enabling physical information to participate directly in molecular generation rather than serving only as a post hoc filter or refinement step.
items.summary_zh: 把机器学习原子间势（MLIP）产生的力作为 RFDiffusion3 全原子肽设计反向扩散后期的推理时引导，而非生成后的固定身份能量最小化。在 8 个受体体系中，作者报告复合物位阻冲突降低 24.7%、肽内冲突降低 37.4%，并以独立 MM/GBSA 作能量检查。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该框架无需重训生成模型，尝试让原子级物理信息影响后续残基选择，具有可迁移的方法学价值。证据仍集中于结构冲突和计算能量代理，未报告设计肽的结合、生物活性或实验成功率。
items.abstract_zh: 基于扩散的生物分子生成模型能够高效探索肽—受体序列—结构空间，但所学习的生成分布并不显式表征底层原子级势能景观。因此，即使生成的复合物在学习到的结构先验下看似合理，也可能包含局部不利的原子排列。本文开发了一种推理时物理引导框架，将机器学习原子间势（MLIP）导出的力耦合至 RFDiffusion3 的全原子反向扩散轨迹，用于受体条件化肽设计。该方法不是在生成后施加能量最小化，而是在联合序列—结构轨迹终止之前引入原子级物理信息。因此，MLIP 导出的力提供原子坐标校正，并通过后续去噪步骤传播，使物理信息不仅影响原子几何，也影响后续残基选择。该框架既不需要重训练，也不修改预训练扩散模型，并使用后期力引导、自适应步长控制和保持几何的投影来保留底层生成先验。在针对肽设计的八个受体体系中，MLIP 引导将肽—受体位阻冲突降低了 24.7%，将肽内冲突降低了 37.4%，同时促进了更有利于氢键的界面几何。无论在引导用的 MACE 势中还是在独立的 MM/GBSA 评估中，引导结构均转向更有利的能量区域，82.4%的保留结构呈现更有利的 MM/GBSA 能量估计。这些改进是在肽主链偏差中位数仅为 0.051 Å 的条件下实现的。重要的是，95.0%的生成肽序列得到保留，5.0%发生残基替换，表明物理引导可以反馈至序列—结构生成，而不会全局覆盖学习到的 RFDiffusion3 分布。这将推理时物理引导与生成后松弛区分开来；后者仅在固定化学身份下优化坐标。更广泛地说，这些结果建立了一种通用策略，可将预训练生物分子生成器与可微原子级能量模型耦合，使物理信息直接参与分子生成，而不仅作为事后筛选或精修。

items.title: StateFlux: Physically Validated Quantum Metabolic State Networks Reveal Limited Incremental Value for Toxicity Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Mechanistic molecular representations are increasingly proposed as a route to improve toxicity prediction by supplementing parent structure with protonation, metabolism, and quantum-chemical reactivity. Whether those physically richer representations provide predictive information that is genuinely orthogonal to molecular structure remains uncertain. Here, StateFlux represents each drug as a network of chemical and predicted metabolic states with node-level GFN2-xTB properties and edge-resolved changes in ionization potential, electron affinity, electrophilicity, solvation, and local reactivity. On a locked DILIrank 2.0 development set (n = 376; 156 DILI-positive and 220 DILI-negative compounds), 10 × 5 scaffold validation gave AUROC/AUPRC values of 0.8249/0.7727 for ECFP, 0.8049/0.7430 for ECFP + FluxCore, and 0.8010/0.7261 for ECFP + StateFluxCore. The FluxCore AUROC decrement relative to ECFP was -0.0199 (95% paired-bootstrap CI, -0.0341 to -0.0072). Strict temporal and scaffold-novel tests likewise showed no consistent advantage, and an independent 5,367-compound genotoxicity benchmark reproduced the result (AUROC 0.7765 for ECFP versus 0.7732 for StateFluxCore). To distinguish limited predictive utility from inaccurate low-cost quantum chemistry, 24 parent-to-metabolite transformations were re-evaluated with 144 ωB97X-D/6-31+G*/SMD single-point calculations. GFN2-xTB closely tracked DFT changes in electrophilicity (Pearson r = 0.963; MAE = 0.408 eV; 79.2% sign agreement). Thus, transformation-induced quantum reactivity can be physically meaningful without providing reliable incremental information for broad toxicity classification. These results argue that mechanistic fidelity and predictive utility should be validated separately when increasingly elaborate molecular representations are introduced into chemical machine learning.
items.summary_zh: StateFlux 将药物表示为包含质子化和预测代谢状态的网络，并整合 GFN2-xTB 量子性质；在 DILIrank 2.0、严格时间/骨架新颖性测试和 5,367 化合物遗传毒性基准中，均未超过 ECFP。对 24 个转化的 DFT 复核显示低成本量子变化本身准确。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是高价值的负结果：物理上可信的机制表征不自动带来毒性分类的增量预测信息。其锁定集、骨架验证、独立基准及 DFT 检查较为扎实；但结论针对这些表征、端点和模型设定，不能外推为所有机制模型无效。
items.abstract_zh: 机制性分子表征日益被提出，作为通过补充母体结构的质子化、代谢和量子化学反应性来改善毒性预测的一条途径。这些物理上更丰富的表征是否提供了真正正交于分子结构的预测信息仍不确定。本文中，StateFlux 将每种药物表示为一个化学和预测代谢状态网络，其节点包含 GFN2-xTB 性质，边解析电离势、电子亲和能、亲电性、溶剂化和局部反应性的变化。在锁定的 DILIrank 2.0 开发集（n = 376；156 种 DILI 阳性和 220 种 DILI 阴性化合物）上，10 × 5 骨架验证为 ECFP、ECFP + FluxCore 和 ECFP + StateFluxCore 分别给出 AUROC/AUPRC 值 0.8249/0.7727、0.8049/0.7430 和 0.8010/0.7261。FluxCore 相对于 ECFP 的 AUROC 降幅为 -0.0199（95%配对 bootstrap CI，-0.0341 至 -0.0072）。严格的时间和骨架新颖性测试同样未显示一致优势，而独立的 5,367 化合物遗传毒性基准复现了该结果（ECFP 的 AUROC 为 0.7765，而 StateFluxCore 为 0.7732）。为区分有限预测效用与不准确的低成本量子化学，我们用 144 个 ωB97X-D/6-31+G*/SMD 单点计算重新评估了 24 个母体至代谢物转化。GFN2-xTB 紧密追踪了 DFT 的亲电性变化（Pearson r = 0.963；MAE = 0.408 eV；79.2%符号一致）。因此，转化诱导的量子反应性可以在物理上有意义，却无法为广泛毒性分类提供可靠的增量信息。这些结果表明，在化学机器学习中引入日益复杂的分子表征时，应分别验证机制保真度和预测效用。

items.title: Assessing the state of the art in ADMET prediction: Lessons from the OpenADMET-ExpansionRx community blind challenge
items.abstract_or_text: Computational blind challenges are essential for advancing drug discovery, especially in research areas with limited public data, such as absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, toxicity (ADMET) prediction. In this paper, we present the results of our latest community blind challenge, organized in collaboration with Expansion Therapeutics (ExpansionRx). Participants were tasked with predicting nine distinct ADMET endpoints routinely evaluated during lead optimization of compounds in drug discovery programs. Following unprecedented engagement from the global community, this challenge provided valuable insights into the state of the art in machine learning for ADMET modeling. Evaluating submissions against a realistic, challenging dataset from active ExpansionRx drug discovery programs revealed that message-passing neural networks and chemical foundation models dominated among the top performers. Furthermore, the results highlighted the power of proprietary industry datasets and a critical need to optimize predictive workflows for different endpoints independently via multitasking and task-affinity grouping. We also demonstrate how hosting our open-source blind challenge infrastructure on a flexible platform like Hugging Face was pivotal for driving community engagement and visibility. Ultimately, blind challenges supported by robust infrastructure, widespread dissemination, and rigorous post-challenge analysis are fundamental to maximizing the utility of public data releases. We anticipate that these community benchmarks will continue to drive the advancement of ADMET models, enabling their deployment in both early- and late-stage drug discovery.
items.summary_zh: 总结与 Expansion Therapeutics 合作开展的 OpenADMET-ExpansionRx 社区盲测：参赛者预测 9 个先导优化中常用的 ADMET 端点，并在真实产业数据上评估。结果显示消息传递神经网络与化学基础模型表现领先，并提示不同端点需独立优化和按任务亲和性分组。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 盲测比同源随机划分更接近药物研发中的泛化压力，且公开基础设施有助于复现与后续比较。摘要未给出逐端点数值、数据披露范围和模型间统计差异，实际可复用性仍取决于挑战数据及评测细节。
items.abstract_zh: 计算盲测对于推进药物发现至关重要，尤其是在吸收、分布、代谢、排泄、毒性（ADMET）预测等公共数据有限的研究领域。本文介绍我们与 Expansion Therapeutics（ExpansionRx）合作组织的最新社区盲测结果。参与者的任务是预测药物发现项目先导化合物优化过程中常规评估的九个不同 ADMET 端点。全球社区前所未有的参与度使这项挑战对 ADMET 机器学习建模的最新水平提供了有价值的洞见。针对来自活跃 ExpansionRx 药物发现项目的真实且具有挑战性的数据集评估提交结果显示，消息传递神经网络和化学基础模型在顶尖表现者中占主导地位。此外，结果凸显了专有产业数据的力量，以及通过多任务和任务亲和性分组针对不同端点分别优化预测工作流的关键需求。我们还展示了如何将开源盲测基础设施托管在如 Hugging Face 这样的灵活平台上，对于推动社区参与和可见性至关重要。最终，由强健基础设施、广泛传播和严格赛后分析支持的盲测，是最大化公共数据发布效用的基础。我们预计，这些社区基准将继续推动 ADMET 模型进步，使其能够部署于药物发现的早期和后期阶段。

items.title: Reaction-aware hypergraph learning of chemical representations with LARK
items.abstract_or_text: Molecular pretraining offers a route to learning transferable chemical representations from unlabelled data. However, existing approaches pretrained on isolated molecular structures struggle to generalize to reaction-specific tasks because their pretraining objectives provide limited information about chemical transformations. A key challenge is to integrate this reaction information into chemical representations. Here we introduce LARK, a unified framework for learning atom-molecule-reaction knowledge from chemical transformations. Using approximately 0.6 million reactions encompassing 0.88 million unique molecular components, LARK combines bidirectional bond-electron reconstruction with structural and geometric supervision through a role-aware hierarchical hypergraph Transformer that links local atom representations to reaction context. The learned representations transfer to both reaction prediction and single-molecule property prediction, with strong performance across 42 tasks covering reaction outcomes, physicochemical properties, toxicity, metabolism and pharmacokinetics. Reactioncentre analyses show that LARK identifies where bonds break and form, while targeted interventions reveal that the learned atom representations contribute to reconstructing these changes. These findings indicate that LARK learns chemically informative representations of substructures involved in molecular transformations. Together, the results establish chemical transformations as a source of structured supervision for representation learning across molecular and reaction scales.
items.summary_zh: LARK 以约 60 万条反应、88 万个唯一分子组分训练具角色感知层级超图 Transformer，通过双向键—电子重建以及结构、几何监督共同学习原子—分子—反应知识。模型在覆盖反应、性质、毒性、代谢和药代的 42 项任务上报告强性能，并分析断键/成键中心。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把化学转化而非孤立分子作为预训练监督，可连接反应预测与分子性质任务，数据尺度和干预分析是亮点。摘要没有给出各任务基线和数值，且跨任务的总体性能可能掩盖特定端点的失败模式。
items.abstract_zh: 分子预训练为从无标注数据中学习可迁移的化学表征提供了一条途径。然而，现有在孤立分子结构上预训练的方法难以泛化至反应特异性任务，因为其预训练目标提供的化学转化信息有限。一个关键挑战是将这种反应信息整合到化学表征中。本文提出 LARK，一个从化学转化中学习原子—分子—反应知识的统一框架。LARK 使用约 0.6 百万条反应、涵盖 0.88 百万个唯一分子组分，将双向键—电子重建与结构和几何监督相结合，采用连接局部原子表征和反应语境的角色感知层级超图 Transformer。学习到的表征可迁移至反应预测和单分子性质预测，在覆盖反应结果、物理化学性质、毒性、代谢和药代动力学的 42 项任务中表现强劲。反应中心分析表明，LARK 能够识别键在哪里断裂和形成，而有针对性的干预显示，学习到的原子表征有助于重建这些变化。这些发现表明，LARK 学到了参与分子转化的子结构的化学信息性表征。总之，这些结果将化学转化确立为跨分子和反应尺度表征学习的结构化监督来源。

items.title: Design of High-Ionic-Conductivity Doped Li2ZrO3 Cathode Coating with Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials
items.abstract_or_text: Li2ZrO3 (LZO) is a promising cathode coating material for all-solid-state batteries, but its intrinsically low ionic conductivity limits rate performance. Here, we investigate the effects of Y3+, Al3+, Nb5+, and Ta5+ doping and amorphization on the Li+ conductivity of LZO using density functional theory (DFT) and machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs). Among the dopants studied, Y3+ substitution exhibits the most favorable defect formation energies. Molecular dynamics simulations using a fine-tuned moment tensor potential (MTP) reveal that 6%-Y-doped crystalline LZO (c-LYZO) achieves a maximum room-temperature ionic conductivity of ∼2mS cm−1, an order of magnitude improvement over undoped LZO. Amorphization was also found to enhance the conductivity of undoped LZO but the effect is attenuated in doped LZO. We show that amorphous LYZO exhibits more spatially fragmented, trapping-dominated Li transport than its crystalline counterpart. These results identify Y-doped LZO as a potential high-conductivity cathode coating and provide a design framework that balances dopant chemistry, defect type, doping concentration, and structural order.
items.summary_zh: 结合 DFT 与微调 moment tensor potential 的 MLIP，比较 Y3+、Al3+、Nb5+、Ta5+ 掺杂及非晶化对 Li2ZrO3 阴极涂层 Li+ 传导的影响。模拟指出 6%-Y 掺杂晶态 LZO 在室温可达约 2 mS cm−1，较未掺杂体系提高一个数量级。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把缺陷化学、掺杂浓度和结构有序性放在同一计算设计框架中，为全固态电池涂层提供具体候选。结论目前来自 DFT/MLIP-MD，导电率及电极兼容性仍需合成、界面和循环实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: Li2ZrO3（LZO）是有前景的全固态电池阴极涂层材料，但其本征低离子电导率限制了倍率性能。本文利用密度泛函理论（DFT）和机器学习原子间势（MLIP），研究 Y3+、Al3+、Nb5+ 和 Ta5+ 掺杂以及非晶化对 LZO 中 Li+ 电导率的影响。在所研究的掺杂剂中，Y3+ 取代显示出最有利的缺陷形成能。使用微调 moment tensor potential（MTP）的分子动力学模拟显示，6%-Y 掺杂晶态 LZO（c-LYZO）在室温下达到约 2mS cm−1 的最大离子电导率，比未掺杂 LZO 提高一个数量级。还发现，非晶化可提高未掺杂 LZO 的电导率，但在掺杂 LZO 中该效应减弱。我们显示，非晶态 LYZO 呈现更空间碎片化、由陷阱主导的 Li 传输，而非其晶态对应物。结果确定了 Y 掺杂 LZO 作为潜在高电导率阴极涂层，并提供了一个平衡掺杂剂化学、缺陷类型、掺杂浓度和结构有序性的设计框架。
items.author_line: Ting Wang, Zihan Yu, Shyue Ping Ong

items.title: Solid-Phase Standard Enthalpies of Formation from SMILES with a Calibrated Per-Molecule Uncertainty: Application to a 13 606-Compound CHONFCl Inventory
items.abstract_or_text: The standard enthalpy of formation of a solid, ∆fH ◦(s, 298 K), governs the detonation performance and the thermal hazard of an energetic material, yet it is measured for only a few hundred compounds, and 30 % of the compounds measured more than once carry determinations that disagree by more than 20 kJ mol−1. I report a route from a SMILES string to ∆fH ◦(s, 298 K) that returns, together with the value, a molecule-specific standard deviation calibrated against experiment. The gas-phase enthalpy is obtained from the ANI-2x neural network potential evaluated on a connectivity-based hierarchy (CBH-2, with CBH-1 fallback) isodesmic balance in which the nitro group is treated as a single pseudo-atom, without which the balance cannot be closed on a charge-separated nitrogen; a rigid-rotor harmonic-oscillator correction supplies the thermal terms. The sublimation enthalpy is a 32-descriptor additive model fitted to 229 measurements harvested from the NIST Chemistry WebBook. Two systematic shifts that survive leave-one-out validation are removed. The uncertainty is a heteroscedastic Gaussian variance model. The whole chain is validated by a nested leave-one-out procedure in which the sublimation model, the acceptance threshold, the systematic shifts and the variance model are all re-estimated without the compound they predict, and that compound’s own gas-phase reference is withheld: over 281 compounds the mean absolute error is 26.1 kJ mol−1, the mean |z| is 0.80 against 0.80 expected for a well-calibrated Gaussian, and the coverage is 71.2 % at one standard deviation and 93.6 % at two, against 68.3 % and 95.4 % expected. For scale, independent experimental determinations of the same solid deviate from their own median by 7.6 kJ mol−1 on average, so two determinations of one compound typically differ by about twice that. The procedure was applied to an inventory of 13 606 CHONFCl compounds; 13 267 (97.5 %) were predicted in 314 core-hours on a single desktop machine, the remainder being open-shell radicals outside the domain of ANI-2x. I state explicitly, and quantify, the size beyond which the uncertainty model itself extrapolates.
items.summary_zh: 建立从 SMILES 预测固相标准生成焓 ΔfH°(s, 298 K) 且逐分子校准不确定度的流程：以 ANI-2x/CBH 等键反应平衡估算气相焓，以 229 条 NIST 测量训练升华焓模型。嵌套留一验证后用于 13,606 个 CHONFCl 化合物中的 13,267 个预测。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 热化学数据匮乏且实验值本身存在差异时，逐分子不确定度比单点预测更适合用于含能材料与热危害判断。方法的 MAE 仍为 26.1 kJ mol−1，并排除了 ANI-2x 域外开壳层自由基，因此不能替代高风险决策中的直接测量。
items.abstract_zh: 固体的标准生成焓 ∆fH ◦(s, 298 K) 决定含能材料的爆轰性能和热危害，但仅有数百种化合物被测量，而且被多次测量的化合物中有 30%的测定结果相差超过 20 kJ mol−1。本文报告一条从 SMILES 字符串得到 ∆fH ◦(s, 298 K) 的路线；它在返回数值的同时，返回一个相对于实验校准的分子特异性标准差。气相焓由在基于连通性的层级（CBH-2，回退为 CBH-1）等键平衡上评估的 ANI-2x 神经网络势获得；在该平衡中，硝基被作为单一伪原子处理，否则无法在电荷分离的氮上闭合平衡；刚性转子谐振子修正提供热项。升华焓是一个 32 描述符加和模型，拟合于从 NIST Chemistry WebBook 收集的 229 个测量值。去除了在留一验证后仍存留的两个系统偏移。不确定度是异方差高斯方差模型。整个链条通过嵌套留一程序验证，其中升华模型、接受阈值、系统偏移和方差模型均在不含待预测化合物的条件下重新估计，且该化合物自身的气相参考被留出：在 281 种化合物上，平均绝对误差为 26.1 kJ mol−1，平均 |z| 为 0.80，而校准良好的高斯分布预期为 0.80；一个标准差和两个标准差时的覆盖率分别为 71.2%和 93.6%，而预期分别为 68.3%和 95.4%。作为尺度参照，同一固体的独立实验测定相对于其自身中位数平均偏离 7.6 kJ mol−1，因此同一化合物的两次测定通常相差约两倍该值。该流程被应用于包含 13 606 种 CHONFCl 化合物的清单；其中 13 267 种（97.5%）在一台单桌面机器上以 314 核小时得到预测，其余为 ANI-2x 适用域外的开壳层自由基。我明确陈述并量化了不确定度模型自身发生外推的尺寸阈值。

items.title: Embedded Morgan Fingerprints for more efficient molecular property predictions with machine learning
items.abstract_or_text: High-dimensional molecular fingerprints have become a quiet bottleneck for chemical machine learning, where bit collisions in large, chemically diverse datasets and escalating computational costs constrain model discovery. This work introduces the embedded Morgan Fingerprint (eMFP), a post-processing scheme that compresses standard Morgan Fingerprints into continuously valued, lower-dimensional representations governed by a compression factor q. Applied to three molecular datasets of increasing size (RedDB, Non-Fullerene Acceptors and QM9), five regression models and four encoding configurations under scaffold-aware nested cross-validation, eMFP maintains the predictive power of full-length fingerprints for tree-based methods at moderate compression (q≤32), while exhibiting more model- and setting-dependent behaviour elsewhere. Its continuous outputs pair favourably with Fourier Feature Neural Networks, where they interact more naturally with sinusoidal feature mappings than the original binary fingerprints, and consistently shorten training times per trial. Together, these results position eMFP as a simple, drop-in route to more scalable molecular representations that retain accuracy while easing the computational burden of model development.
items.summary_zh: 提出 embedded Morgan Fingerprint（eMFP），按压缩因子 q 将标准 Morgan 指纹后处理为连续低维表示。在 RedDB、Non-Fullerene Acceptors、QM9 三个数据集、五类回归器的骨架感知嵌套交叉验证中，适度压缩（q≤32）可在树模型中保持预测能力并缩短单次训练。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是一种无需改变原始指纹生成流程的轻量化扩展方案，且评测采用骨架感知嵌套验证。结果依赖模型和设定，神经网络等场景并非普遍获益，不能据此假定压缩总是无损。
items.abstract_zh: 高维分子指纹已成为化学机器学习中一个不显眼的瓶颈：在大型、化学多样的数据集中，位碰撞和不断增加的计算成本限制了模型发现。本文引入 embedded Morgan Fingerprint（eMFP），一种后处理方案，以压缩因子 q 为控制参数，将标准 Morgan Fingerprints 压缩为连续值、低维表征。该方法应用于三个规模递增的分子数据集（RedDB、Non-Fullerene Acceptors 和 QM9）、五种回归模型和四种编码配置，并采用骨架感知嵌套交叉验证；eMFP 在中等压缩（q≤32）时可为基于树的方法保持全长指纹的预测能力，但在其他情形下表现出更依赖模型和设置的行为。其连续输出能与 Fourier Feature Neural Networks 有利地配合，在其中它们比原始二值指纹更自然地与正弦特征映射相互作用，并持续缩短每次试验的训练时间。总体而言，eMFP 是一种简单、即插即用的途径，可获得更具可扩展性的分子表征，在减轻模型开发计算负担的同时保持准确度。
items.author_line: Emilio Nuñez-Andrade, Isaac Vidal-Daza, Rafael Gomez-Bombarelli, James W. Ryan, Francisco J. Martin-Martinez

items.title: Multimodal LLM-Assisted Diagnosis of Cryptic Failure Modes in High-Throughput Experimentation: A Case Study in Gold Nanorod Synthesis
items.abstract_or_text: Self-driving labs typically optimize experiments within a predefined design space. Yet high-throughput campaigns can fail for reasons outside this design space, in-cluding reagent state, stock solution quality, and handling history. Here, we present a case study of a five-plate high-throughput gold nanorod synthesis campaign in which a multimodal large language model (LLM) helped diagnose such cryptic failure modes. We used low-cost camera images for rapid assessment of seed and synthesis state, with UV–vis spectroscopy when the images were insufficient for failure diagnosis. The campaign included an abnormal seed batch, a visually plausible synthesis with hidden spectroscopic defects, and a plate-wide failed synthesis in which most wells showed weak spectra with a strong rise toward the near-infrared. In response, the LLM intervened by questioning the seed preparation step and reagent handling instead of optimizing the screened concentrations of silver nitrate and ascorbic acid. To quantify recovery, we defined a UV–vis spectral roughness metric based on local spectral interpolation across the synthesis grid. The final synthesis had the lowest roughness, Rspec = 0.636 compared with ∼ 0.772 for earlier successful runs, and the highest median longitudinal-window absorbance. Our results show the potential of multimodal LLMs upstream of autonomous optimization in self-driving labs to identify when an experiment has failed for reasons outside the nominal design space and when additional characterization is needed before optimization should continue.
items.summary_zh: 以五块板的高通量金纳米棒合成为案例，考察多模态 LLM 如何从低成本相机图像和必要时的 UV–vis 光谱中识别设计空间外的隐蔽失败原因。模型将注意力转向种子制备和试剂处理，而非继续优化 AgNO3、抗坏血酸浓度；最终实验的 Rspec 为 0.636。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把 LLM 的作用从在既定变量内寻优，扩展到判断何时应暂停优化并补充表征，贴近自驱动实验室的实际故障。证据来自单一、规模很小的案例；LLM 的因果贡献、可重复性和跨实验体系泛化仍未确定。
items.abstract_zh: 自驱动实验室通常在预定义设计空间内优化实验。然而，高通量实验活动可能因该设计空间之外的原因失败，包括试剂状态、储备溶液质量和处理历史。本文提出一个五块板高通量金纳米棒合成活动的案例研究，其中多模态大型语言模型（LLM）帮助诊断了这类隐蔽失败模式。我们使用低成本相机图像快速评估种子和合成状态；当图像不足以诊断失败时，使用 UV–vis 光谱。该活动包括一个异常种子批次、一次视觉上看似合理但存在隐藏光谱缺陷的合成，以及一次整板失败的合成——其中大多数孔显示弱光谱并在近红外方向强烈上升。对此，LLM 通过质疑种子制备步骤和试剂处理进行干预，而不是优化所筛选的硝酸银和抗坏血酸浓度。为量化恢复情况，我们定义了一个基于合成网格中局部光谱插值的 UV–vis 光谱粗糙度指标。最终合成具有最低粗糙度，Rspec = 0.636，而先前成功运行约为 0.772，并具有最高的纵向窗口吸光度中位数。结果显示，多模态 LLM 在自主优化上游具有潜力：识别实验何时因名义设计空间之外的原因而失败，以及在优化继续之前何时需要额外表征。
items.author_line: Riya Patel, Gabriela Briceno, Amirali Aghazadeh, Vida Jamali

items.title: Computer Vision for Predicting Electrochemical Reaction Performance from Electroanalytical Data
items.abstract_or_text: Electrosynthesis has surfaced as a key approach in modern synthesis, enabling more sustainable chemical transformations with reduced chemical waste. The accurate prediction of electrosynthesis performance is crucial for accelerating the discovery and design of reactions. Despite indisputable advances, the descriptor-based predictions fall short in representing the full reaction regime due to the high‑dimensional parameter space of electrosynthesis. Cyclic voltammograms, which are typically employed for mechanistic analysis, inherently contain rich information about electrochemical processes. Herein, we applied computer vision techniques to collect a cyclic voltammogram image database and trained a neural network directly on these image data. The resulting models achieved reliable performance in predicting electrosynthesis outcomes, demonstrating the potential of image-based deep learning for electrochemical reaction evaluation and data-driven electrosynthesis studies.
items.summary_zh: 从循环伏安图像建立数据库，并直接以这些图像训练神经网络预测电有机合成结果，旨在让完整伏安曲线所包含的反应状态信息替代部分人工描述符。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将成熟的计算机视觉直接用于电分析图形，为电合成评价提供了低门槛的多信息输入。摘要仅称性能“可靠”，未给出数据规模、预测端点、外部验证或基线数值，证据强度有限。
items.abstract_zh: 电合成已成为现代合成中的关键方法，可实现更可持续、化学废物更少的化学转化。准确预测电合成性能对于加速反应发现和设计至关重要。尽管取得了毋庸置疑的进展，基于描述符的预测仍不足以表征电合成的高维参数空间所对应的完整反应状态。通常用于机理分析的循环伏安图天然包含丰富的电化学过程信息。本文应用计算机视觉技术收集循环伏安图像数据库，并直接在这些图像数据上训练神经网络。所得模型在预测电合成结果方面获得可靠性能，展示了基于图像的深度学习在电化学反应评估和数据驱动电合成研究中的潜力。
items.author_line: Xinran Chen, Sven Erik Peters, Lutz Ackermann

items.title: FiberPro 1.0: Multiagent AI-Guided Design for High-Throughput Production and Conformal Deposition of Functional Protein Micro/Nanofibers
items.abstract_or_text: Functional protein micro/nanofibers integrate high specific surface areas with bioactive architectures but remain hampered low production throughput and severe processing instability. Focused rotary jet spinning (FRJS) shows promising to break these throughput constraints while enabling direct, conformal deposition onto complex, irregular substrates. However, navigating FRJS's narrow processing windows in proteins remains failure-prone without closed-loop experimental guidance. Here, we report FiberPro 1.0, a large language model driven multi agent framework that unites high-throughput spinning with real-time experimental feedback for autonomous design, execution, and optimization. Across three protein systems, FiberPro 1.0 converged on spinnable formulations within an average of two iterations. To demonstrate high-throughput conformal deposition in a translational setting, FiberPro designed a zein-based active packaging system applied directly onto diverse food matrices. The resulting conformal coating combined potent antibacterial activity with real-time freshness monitoring, markedly suppressing Escherichia coli and extending shelf life. This work connects autonomous AI reasoning with high-throughput processing, establishing a verifiable route for scalable manufacturing and conformal coating of functional protein micro/nanofibers.
items.summary_zh: FiberPro 1.0 是由 LLM 驱动、结合实时实验反馈的多智能体框架，用于蛋白微/纳米纤维的 FRJS 配方设计、执行和优化。作者称其在三种蛋白体系中平均两轮得到可纺配方，并将其用于玉米醇溶蛋白活性包装在多类食品表面的共形沉积。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作把多智能体推理与实际高通量加工、抗菌效果和保鲜应用连在一起，展示了自主实验可触达的制造任务。平均两轮收敛和“显著”性能缺乏摘要中的对照细节；适用范围、闭环自主程度和可规模化性需要独立复核。
items.abstract_zh: 功能性蛋白微/纳米纤维将高比表面积与生物活性结构结合，但仍受低生产吞吐量和严重加工不稳定性的阻碍。聚焦旋转射流纺丝（FRJS）显示出打破这些吞吐量限制的前景，同时能够直接、共形地沉积到复杂、不规则的底物上。然而，在蛋白体系中驾驭 FRJS 的狭窄加工窗口，若没有闭环实验引导，仍容易失败。本文报道 FiberPro 1.0，这是一个由大型语言模型驱动的多智能体框架，将高通量纺丝与实时实验反馈结合，用于自主设计、执行和优化。跨三个蛋白体系，FiberPro 1.0 平均在两次迭代内收敛至可纺配方。为在转化场景中展示高通量共形沉积，FiberPro 设计了一种基于玉米醇溶蛋白的活性包装系统，直接施用于多样食品基质。所得共形涂层兼具强抗菌活性和实时新鲜度监测能力，显著抑制 Escherichia coli 并延长保质期。这项工作将自主 AI 推理与高通量加工连接起来，建立了一条可验证路径，用于功能性蛋白微/纳米纤维的可扩展制造和共形涂覆。
items.author_line: Li L, Moses C, Noh Y, Hsu C, Calderon Gutierrez F, Ruiz C, Mogollon Molina JF, Fu K, Chang H

items.title: Polymer Informatics in the Era of Foundation Models: From Representation to Autonomous Design
items.abstract_or_text: Foundation models, pretrained on broad datasets and adapted to multiple tasks, offer a way to reuse chemical knowledge across polymer property prediction and inverse design. Realizing this opportunity requires connecting learned representations to materials whose properties also depend on molecular populations, formulation, processing, and measurement conditions. Here, we review advances in polymer foundation models and the data, representations, and experimental workflows that support their use in materials design. We organize these developments around the polymer material state, a description linking chemical identity to molecular distributions, architecture, morphology, and preparation history relevant to a target property. This organization connects data resources and pretraining strategies to questions about what models learn, how that knowledge transfers, and which experimental choices it can support. We compare learning objectives and adaptation methods, examine representations of polymer chemistry and state, and follow inverse design from candidate generation through synthesis and processing to validation. Pretrained models now support prediction across multiple properties and generation for specified targets, with selected polymer candidates reaching synthesis and thermal characterization. Broader polymer design campaigns show how precursor accessibility, polymerization outcomes, and specimen preparation influence whether a predicted advantage becomes a measured material response. Building on this evidence, we discuss opportunities to combine chemical pretraining with richer sample information and to assess transfer across polymer families, preparation conditions, and experimental campaigns. The resulting synthesis connects model development to a practical objective for polymer informatics: reducing the new experimentation needed to obtain materials with reproducible, targeted performance.
items.summary_zh: 综述聚合物基础模型如何将跨任务预训练与聚合物性质预测、逆向设计相连，并以“聚合物材料状态”组织化学身份、分子量分布、架构、形貌和制备史。文章追踪从候选生成到合成、加工和热表征的证据链。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 聚合物设计的关键难点是模型表征与实际样品状态、加工和测量条件之间的断裂；该综述给出有助于评估可迁移性与实验闭环的框架。它是证据整合而非新方法或新数据，具体模型优劣仍应回到原始研究核验。
items.abstract_zh: 在广泛数据集上预训练并适配于多项任务的基础模型，为在聚合物性质预测和逆向设计中复用化学知识提供了一种方式。实现这一机会需要将学习到的表征与材料联系起来，因为材料性质还取决于分子群体、配方、加工和测量条件。本文综述聚合物基础模型的进展，以及支持其用于材料设计的数据、表征和实验工作流。我们围绕聚合物材料状态来组织这些进展；该描述将化学身份与目标性质相关的分子分布、架构、形貌和制备历史连接起来。这一组织方式将数据资源和预训练策略与模型学到了什么、这些知识如何迁移以及它能够支持哪些实验选择等问题联系起来。我们比较学习目标和适配方法，考察聚合物化学和状态的表征，并追踪逆向设计从候选生成到合成、加工和验证的过程。预训练模型现已支持跨多种性质的预测以及针对指定目标的生成，部分聚合物候选已完成合成和热表征。更广泛的聚合物设计活动显示，前体可获得性、聚合结果和试样制备如何影响预测优势能否成为测得的材料响应。在这些证据基础上，我们讨论将化学预训练与更丰富的样品信息相结合，以及评估跨聚合物家族、制备条件和实验活动迁移的机会。由此形成的综合将模型开发与聚合物信息学的一项目标联系起来：减少获得可重复、目标化性能材料所需的新实验。

review.note: 从 60 项候选中遴选 16 项。优先保留具有外部/盲测评估、实验验证、明确数据规模或可复核负结果的研究；综述仅保留一项用于聚合聚合物基础模型的材料设计证据。
